question: If a court finds a restriction in this Agreement unreasonable, is the entire Agreement voided?
ground_truth_answer: No. The court may instead reduce the scope of the unreasonable restriction rather than void the entire Agreement (a blue-pencil / severability provision).

expected_citations.span_hint: If a court finds any restriction in this Agreement unreasonable, the court may reduce the scope of the restriction rather than void the entire Agreement.
